basics.name: Devi Adi Nufriana
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Frontend and full-stack engineer based in Jakarta. Over 7 years building and modernizing production web applications with Vue, React, and Go at Blibli, BRI Life, and Frisidea.

work.name: BRI Life
work.summary: Full-stack engineer responsible for analyzing business problems and collaborating with cross-functional teams within the digital integration team to design and improve system workflows, reducing redundancy and increasing operational efficiency.
highlights: Analyzed and optimized existing workflows to reduce redundancy and improve system efficiency
Designed and implemented a notification microservice to support scalable system integration
Integrated third-party systems such as WA, SMS, email, and push notifications
Collaborated with multiple teams to streamline integration processes across systems
Implemented CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI to improve deployment automation

work.name: Blibli
work.summary: Frontend Engineer leading UI modernization and performance optimization initiatives. Spearheaded migration of legacy systems to Vue.js and implemented comprehensive integration testing.
highlights: Redesigned and migrated the Review Center page from Java to Vue, modernizing the frontend stack and UX.
Refactored the Review, Hall of Fame, and latest pages to the latest Vue version using modular, reusable components.
Built end-to-end integration test suites with Playwright to catch regressions before production release.
Refined the UI Detail page and implemented frontend performance optimizations.

work.name: Frisidea
work.summary: Full-stack Developer modernizing web applications for insurance and customer care platforms using React and Vite.
highlights: Upgraded and enhanced the TMLI web application using modern React and Vite practices.
Improved the responsive UI/UX of kitasiap.com to align with user and client requirements.
Built a web-based customer care portal for the insurance industry to streamline policy access.
Managed Nginx configuration and deployments on Linux servers.

work.name: BRI Life
work.summary: Full-stack Developer responsible for migrating the 'Mylife' mobile app to Flutter and building internal web applications with React and Express.js.
highlights: Led the migration of the 'Mylife' mobile application from React Native to Flutter.
Built and maintained the 'Digiform' web app in ReactJS alongside Express.js backend APIs.
Managed three concurrent application projects, including Linux server setup and production deployments.

projects.name: Resume Lab
projects.description: A modern, ATS-friendly resume lab built with Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS. Create professional resumes by uploading JSON files or filling in forms manually, then generate PDFs optimized for Applicant Tracking Systems.
highlights: Built a modern, ATS-friendly resume lab using Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS
Implemented JSON file upload and manual form entry for resume creation
Developed PDF generation with ATS optimization for professional resumes
Created a user-friendly interface for resume management and customization
Integrated modern web technologies for a seamless user experience

projects.name: Mortgage Loan
projects.description: A modern, responsive Mortgage Calculator (Simulasi KPR) built with React and Vite. This application helps users estimate their monthly mortgage payments, taking into account both fixed and floating interest rates.

projects.name: Sistem Skripsi
projects.description: The thesis process becomes more organized and faster, carried out online and can be accessed anywhere via a browser with the aim of saving time, energy and making it easier to obtain information on the thesis process online.
